name: pet_adoption_listings
description: The rewrite splits the listings query into a base listings query plus a shelter lookup per row, introducing an N+1 query pattern on the hot listings endpoint.
flaw: The rewrite replaced the single JOIN query with a per-row get_shelter_by_id call inside the response-building loop of handle_listings (optimized/main.py, the 'for row in rows' loop near line 10). With up to 200 listings this issues 1 + N queries instead of 1, an N+1 regression on the hot path.
